notes: QoL Index is a composite score (0–100) designed for the working majority.
It combines cost-of-living relief, time/burden, health/stress, housing security, mobility, education opportunity, and civic power.
This is a scaffold: weights and proxies are placeholders and will be replaced with sourced indicators and validated methodology.

dimensions.name: Household Economic Burden
dimensions.why: How much of life is spent servicing unavoidable costs (health, housing, debt, utilities, transport).
dimensions.proxy: Cumulative household burden from Household Impact Simulator (lower is better).

dimensions.name: Health & Stress
dimensions.why: Preventable illness, mental distress, and burnout reduce life expectancy and opportunity.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: improves with universal care + reduced financial stress (derived from healthcare relief + debt relief).

dimensions.name: Housing Security
dimensions.why: Stable housing is the platform for education, work, and family life.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: housing relief + landlord-tenant protections; measured later with eviction/overcrowding metrics.

dimensions.name: Mobility & Time
dimensions.why: Time is wealth. Commuting burden and access to services determines opportunity, especially rural.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: transport relief + universal access investments; later: commute time + access indices.

dimensions.name: Education Opportunity
dimensions.why: Free education and lifelong skills raise productivity and civic stability.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: education relief + student-debt elimination; later: attainment + training access.

dimensions.name: Civic Power & Trust
dimensions.why: When the process is fair and transparent, people participate and corruption falls.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: transparency/accountability reforms; later: participation + trust indices.

dimensions.name: Future Resilience (AI & shocks)
dimensions.why: A stable future means AI gains benefit everyone and shocks don’t destroy households.
dimensions.proxy: Placeholder: People’s Wealth Fund growth + stabilizers; later: volatility + employment transition rates.

normalization.notes: For each proxy, score is normalized between SQ and WMR trajectories for the selected horizon and band. Placeholder until empirical scaling is added.
